response.sql:
WITH race_stats AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        c.country,
        COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count,
        SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        race_stats.*,
        AVG(entry_count) OVER () AS average_entry_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY entry_count DESC) AS entry_count_rank
    FROM race_stats
)
SELECT
    raceId,
    country,
    total_points,
    entry_count,
    entry_count - average_entry_count AS above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE entry_count > average_entry_count
  AND entry_count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_average DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The average is across all races, including races with no constructor result entries; such races have an entry count of zero. The tenth-highest cutoff includes ties, so the query ranks distinct entry-count values.
